option.name: v2v_coop_signal
option.default: OFF (bool; everything byte-identical when off; requires v2v_intent=True)
option.summary: each CAV's policy gets a small extra zero-initialised head off the shared 64-wide actor trunk: one logit for p_coop (sigmoid; probability 'I am in a cooperative manoeuvre') and K+1 yield-slot logits (softmax over the K=4 partner slots + none; 'I am giving way to this partner'). Broadcast with the SAME t-1 latency as the planned-command intents (sample['published_coop']); partners observe 2 extra features per partner slot (partner_p_coop, yield_target) through ZERO-INITIALISED input columns, so the loaded policy acts identically.
option.block_layout: [gap_m, lane_offset, v_mps, a_mps2, last_cmd, present, intent_1..intent_H, intent_valid, partner_p_coop, yield_target] * K
option.dims: v2v_dim = v2v_coop_dim(4, 5) = 56 with the coop signal (48 = K*(6+H+1) without it); per-partner slot stride 14 = 6+H+1+2
option.coop_columns: 2 per partner slot at offsets slot*14+12..slot*14+13 (tools/coopmwm/v2v_obs.coop_columns)

config_keys.v2v_coop_signal: bool, default False; requires v2v_intent=True (ValueError otherwise, in vi.settings and v2v_runner.prepare)
config_keys.v2v_coop_signal_loss_weight: float, default 1.0 when on; must be finite and >= 0
config_keys.v2v_dim: must equal v2v_coop_dim(K, H) = 56 when on (validated by v2v_intent.settings)
config_keys.identical_for_arms: v2v_runner.prepare(...) emits the SAME coop keys for A, B and R (arm-agnostic binding, like the intent keys)
config_keys.A_arm: A runs the same IntentPolicy coop head from the same u0; A has no bank (b_replay only for B/R), so no pair of A ever carries coop_targets

training_targets.source: bank pairs of entries whose plan is labelled cooperative within its seed (the confirmation record's existing cooperation label, computed on the first seed; replay_bank.bank_pairs coop.get('cooperative') is True)
training_targets.p_coop: plan members of those pairs get p_coop target 1 (tools/coopmwm/v2v_intent.attach_coop_targets: sample['coop_targets'][vid] = [1., yield_slot or None])
training_targets.yield_target: the plan member whose gap their deceleration opens, determined from the plan only: the member's own plan-window commands must contain a deceleration (min command < 0, pure sign rule - NO hand-set behavioural threshold), and the target is the NEAREST other plan member in the SAME lane BEHIND them at the plan-start trace frame (max s_m, vid tie-break); the slot index is resolved through the pair's recorded partner ranking (intent_link.slots); not determinable or not among the partner slots -> none (CE target = none class)
training_targets.masking: ALL other pairs (non-cooperative bank entries) and ALL PPO rollouts get NO coop supervision (masked): the coop term exists only in bank_imitation's bank_term over pairs carrying coop_targets; p_coop is never pushed down outside cooperative plans; PPOIntent.term touches only the intent head
training_targets.loss: BCE(p_coop logit) + CE(yield logits over K slots + none) per supervised member, mean over members, times v2v_coop_signal_loss_weight; shares the intent trunk-detach setting (v2v_intent_detach_trunk, default True)
training_targets.inputs_refresh: bank coop INPUTS are built empty (zeros) at pair attach and recomputed every update by v2v_intent.refresh_bank_intents from the CURRENT head on each partner's own t-1 bank context (deployment-consistent; yield slot resolved via the t-1 pair's recorded ranking; never recorded commands), exactly like the intent inputs

fairness_note: CONSEQUENCE FOR ARM A (documented as required): A has no bank, and coop supervision exists ONLY on bank pairs of cooperative plans - PPO rollouts are masked by design. A's coop head therefore receives NO gradient ever (its output feeds nothing in the action path and the coop loss never sees an A pair), so it stays frozen at its zero initialisation for the whole run: A permanently publishes p_coop=0.5 and a uniform yield distribution, and its partner coop-signal input columns stay at their zero initialisation. B and R (bank arms) learn the head. This is a real asymmetry: with v2v_coop_signal ON, B/R get an extra supervised signalling channel A cannot learn. It is disclosed here and in the binding keys (identical for every arm) so the A/B/R comparison under this option is interpreted with A as the no-bank reference, exactly like the existing intent-head asymmetry (A's intent head trains only from PPO own-command targets, which DO exist for A).

wiring.v2v_obs: v2v_coop_dim/published_coop/coop_columns/V2V_COOP_SIGNAL_FEATURES; v2v_intent_features(..., coop=dict(board)) appends the 2 coop features per slot at the same t-1 validity rule (published exactly at now-1, p in [0,1]; coop validity independent of intent validity)
wiring.v2v_intent: settings/config_keys coop keys; IntentPolicy._attach_intent(..., coop) adds zero-init coop_head Linear(64, 1+K+1); coop()/publish_coop(); resolve_yield/resolve_coop (deterministic argmax, lowest index on ties, none index or empty slot -> None); coop_terms/coop_bank_term/coop_bank_stats; bank_term adds the coop term only when policy.coop_enabled; bank_stats/weight_norms gain coop keys only when on; attach_coop_targets + yield_target_vid; refresh_bank_intents writes coop inputs and reports coop_slots/coop_slots_valid only when on; loaders accept u0/v2v-only(24)/intent(48)/coop(56) checkpoints into a coop policy with ZERO new input columns and zero heads (actions identical at load; Adam moments kept/re-gridded); a coop checkpoint requires v2v_coop_signal on (ValueError otherwise); from_weights detects coop from state-dict keys
wiring.bank_v2v: intent dict gains coop=dict(board); _block_dim/_intent_features honour it; attach_pairs builds coop inputs EMPTY (zeros)
wiring.replay_bank: bank_pairs(..., v2v_intent=binding) detects v2v_coop_signal in the binding, passes coop board placeholder to attach_pairs and calls vi.attach_coop_targets on the kept pairs of cooperative entries; summary gains 'v2v_coop_signal' (supervised_pairs/unsupervised_pairs) ONLY when on
wiring.v2v_runtime: controller_class Controller keeps coop_board (vid -> (published second, p_coop, yield vid)); Proxy publishes sample['published_coop'] (resolved against the frame's partner ranking) and passes the coop board into the observation spec; all gated on policy.coop_enabled
wiring.v2v_runner: prepare(..., v2v_coop_signal=False, v2v_coop_signal_loss_weight=1.) adds the coop keys when v2v_intent is on; explicit ValueError when coop is set without v2v_intent or with v2v_dim != 56
wiring.v2v_live: hooks() policy_factory constructs IntentPolicy(..., coop, coop_loss_weight) from the resolved settings; bank_pairs hook unchanged (the binding dict carries the coop keys)
wiring.exact_grade: exact_update report['v2v_intent'] gains coop_target_rule and coop_loss/coop_members_supervised/coop_pairs in before/after (bank_stats) ONLY when the policy has coop enabled; coverage() is stride-aware
